question: In a woodworking facility, fine wood dust accumulated in a closed processing chamber. Secondary Dust Explosion — A larger explosion resulting from dust that was previously unsettled by another explosion.

Fireball — A large, spherical fire created by the explosive ignition of a flammable gas.
